objective: Close the fourteen fold boxes left by the fixed-120-degree orthogonal-plane weave certificate through a canonical limiting exclusion, without defining a new acceleration law.

frozenInputs.modificationRule: All four frozen inputs are read-only controls for this extension.

canonicalFoldLaw.finiteOrderTransit: A nondegenerate transverse fold is routed through the canonical caustic-transit chart: its ordinary branch acceleration scales as abs(T_r-T_r*)^(-1/2), is locally integrable in reception time, and is not assigned a finite pointwise acceleration at D_t=0.
canonicalFoldLaw.persistentFold: A persistent interval with D_t=0 is outside the finite-impulse lemma and remains a regularized-chart failure.
canonicalFoldLaw.coincidentSelfBirth: The x=0 coincident self root is excluded; a coincident same-transmitter root birth is not an accepted fold transition under the finite-regulator theorem target.

analyticalReduction.crossTransversality: At a crossPlus or crossMinus fold at phi=0, D_r=-beta_f^2*(F_phi+F_x)/(2*x)=1 exactly, so the reception phase crosses a nondegenerate fold transversely.
analyticalReduction.persistentIdentity: For self and partner circular rows, the causal equation depends only on delay; D_r=D_t. Hence D_t=0 persists for every reception phase at an interior fold beta_f.

relevantComponents.self: each born root contributes +2*beta_f*sin(x)/(x^2*abs(H_x)) to the tangent component near the fold
relevantComponents.partner: each born root contributes 2*beta_f*sin(x)/(x^2*abs(H_x))<0 to the tangent component near the fold
relevantComponents.crossPlus: each born root contributes -2*beta_f*cos(x)/(x^2*abs(H_x))<0 to the plane-normal component near the fold
relevantComponents.crossMinus: each born root contributes -2*beta_f*cos(x)/(x^2*abs(H_x))>0 to the plane-normal component near the fold

analyticalReduction.limitingExclusion: On the beta_f>beta_* side, the two roots born at every interior lobe minimum have one common transmitter, polarity, limiting line of action, and same-signed relevant transverse projection. Their combined magnitude diverges while all nonfold rows remain bounded. On the beta_f<beta_* side, the target pair is absent and the frozen root-sheet oracle interval-encloses the reduced transverse sum away from zero. At beta_f=beta_*, a persistent fold is a chart failure and a transverse fold has no finite pointwise acceleration; either disposition fails the declared every-phase acceleration-balance condition.
analyticalReduction.betaOneBoundary: At beta_f=1, 2-2*cos(x)<x^2 for every x>0, so no nontrivial self root exists. The coincident root is excluded and the remaining phase-zero tangent sum is interval-enclosed away from zero. For beta_f>1 the born self contribution is positive and divergent.

outcomePolicy.boundedNoBalance: The prior ordinary charts plus all fourteen closed fold boxes cover beta_f in [0.25,12], and every beta_f fails a necessary finite pointwise transverse acceleration condition.
outcomePolicy.unresolved: At least one box lacks a certified no-root-side exclusion, a root-side dominance bound, or a canonical exact-fold disposition.

claimBoundary.model: default uncapped canonical Master Equation with its existing caustic-transit and persistent-fold routing
doesNotEstablish: balance or failure outside beta_f in [0.25,12]
failure of variable-speed, breathing, or precessing-plane histories
sharp-limit convergence of the dual-mollified equation at unrelated caustics

falsifiers: A fold box contains an ordinary beta_f at which both phase-zero transverse components vanish.
A target fold pair has opposite leading transverse signs or is canceled by another simultaneous unbounded contribution for the same receiver.
A self or partner interior fold is not persistent in reception phase, or a cross fold has D_r=0.
The canonical Master Equation supplies a finite pointwise D_t=0 acceleration that replaces the frozen caustic routing.
Any frozen input hash differs from the protocol binding.
